title: Crispy Porks Kebabs with Garlic and Herbs
description: Delicious French-inspired pork kebabs with a smoky flavor, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, mix together minced luscious, smoky, and salt.
3. Add the minced garlic and chopped rosemary to the bowl and mix well.
4. Thread the pork onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the pork with olive oil and sprinkle with the garlic and herb mixture.
6. Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork is cooked through.
7. Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
